nodes.title: SG-6.3 · Split ContributionSheet, AdminApp and App
nodes.body:
Context: ContributionSheet.tsx (175 lines), AdminApp.tsx (164) and App.tsx (56) mix state, effects and markup. Desired behavior: each file is split into small subcomponents and hooks, each file under 200 lines. Expected result: same rendered output, and api/client.ts calls and payloads unchanged. Why: SG-6 requires large components to be small and maintainable.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the three components, When files are measured, Then each file in game/frontend/src is under 200 lines
- Given existing component tests, When run unchanged, Then they pass with the same rendered output
- Given api/client.ts, When the split lands, Then the same endpoints and payloads are called


## Scope
- In scope: ContributionSheet
- In scope: AdminApp
- In scope: App
- Out of scope: backend/
- Out of scope: api/client.ts changes
- Out of scope: new features
- Preserve: Rendered DOM and text
- Preserve: Radix dialog focus behaviour
- Preserve: Exports describeRoundError, errorMessage, HistoryStatus


## Technical constraints
- Phaser stays pinned at ~3.90.0 and the phaser-pin guard test keeps passing
- No change to what the player sees or can do
- npm test and npm run typecheck pass in game/ and game/frontend/
- No test deleted or skipped
- No source file in game/src or game/frontend/src over 200 lines
- game/src never imports from game/frontend
- Zustand store is the only owner of GameState
- backend/ and the contribution/round API out of scope
- Tests mock only what is external


## Definition of done
- All three requirements verified
- Existing tests green


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · ContributionSheet is split into hooks and subcomponents under 200 lines
nodes.body:
Context: ContributionSheet.tsx holds history loading, submit logic and markup. Desired behavior: move history loading and submit logic into hooks and the history status list into a subcomponent. Expected result: identical DOM, same listMine and submitContribution calls. Why: SG-6.3.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the split, When ContributionSheet.tsx and each new file are measured, Then each is under 200 lines
- Given the sheet opens, When history loads, fails or is empty, Then the same messages, Retry button and test ids render
- Given a submit, When blank, over limit, zero quota or success, Then the same messages render and submitContribution gets the same prompt


## Scope
- In scope: ContributionSheet.tsx
- In scope: new files under components/contribution
- Out of scope: api/client.ts
- Preserve: Props open, onClose, roundId, returnFocusRef
- Preserve: Exports errorMessage and HistoryStatus


## Technical constraints
- No file over 200 lines
- api/client.ts calls and payloads unchanged
- Radix Dialog focus trap and return focus kept


## Definition of done
- Sheet split and wired in
- Existing contribution tests pass


## Clarifying questions
- None

- Given a 401, When any request fails, Then the token gate shows 'Invalid token' as before
- Given Create, Open and Close clicks, When pressed, Then createRound, openRound and closeRound are called with the same arguments and the round reloads

- In scope: new files under components/admin
- Out of scope: api/client.ts

nodes.title: REQ · App delegates the playing view to a GameScreen subcomponent
nodes.body:
Context: App.tsx mixes the intro gate, round load, sheet state and the layout composition. Desired behavior: move sheet state, trigger ref and layout composition into GameScreen. Expected result: same DOM before and after Begin, loadRound called once on mount. Why: SG-6.3.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given App mounts, When not begun, Then IntroScreen shows and loadRound is called once
- Given Begin is pressed, When GameScreen renders, Then header, Phaser host, ObjectOverlay, ContributionSheet and StoryPanel render as before
- Given the Suggest button, When pressed, Then the sheet opens with roundId from the store and focus returns to the button on close


## Scope
- In scope: App.tsx
- In scope: components/GameScreen.tsx
- Out of scope: GameLayout internals
- Preserve: Export describeRoundError from App
- Preserve: default export App


## Technical constraints
- No file over 200 lines
- Zustand store remains the only GameState owner


## Definition of done
- GameScreen wired into App
- Existing app tests pass


## Clarifying questions
- None
